4번째 가로줄의 메모 5를 봅니다.\n5가 들어갈 수 있는 곳이 세 곳입:
Look at note 5 in row 4.
5 has three spots it can go in.
If the left cell is 5,
5 can't go in any cell that sees it.
하지만 왼쪽 칸이 5가 아니어도\n가운데 칸이 5라고 정해지지는 않습니다:
But if the left cell is not 5,
that doesn't make the middle cell 5.
The 5 could go in the right cell.
한 칸에 5가 들어가면 다른 칸의 메모 5가 지워지는\n두 칸을 약한 연:
Two cells where a 5 in one removes
note 5 from the other are called a weak link.
Strong links are drawn as solid lines,
weak links as dotted lines.
In a strong link, if one side is not 5,
the other side is 5.
In a weak link, if 5 goes in one side,
note 5 is removed from the other side.
강한 연결의 두 칸도 한쪽에 5가 들어가면\n다른 쪽의 메모 5가 지워집:
In a strong link too, if 5 goes in one side,
note 5 is removed from the other side.
So a strong link is also a weak link.
If the marked cell is settled as 5,
tap every cell whose note 5 is removed.
This cell doesn't see the marked cell, so its note 5 stays.
Right. This cell's note 5 is removed.
Tap a cell other than the marked cell.
Right. The marked cell and each cell you found are a weak link.
2. Check whether the two cells see each other.
